args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE new KFB 3x2 landscape transparent PNG character sheet, EXACTLY SIX unique absurd-surreal weird claymation INK BLOB MONSTERS, a fictional retro The Pending Innings sports team. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets: image1 rounded sculpted whole ink-body material; image2 handcrafted prop/material craft. Do not copy source costume, eyes or repeated grins. 1930s vintage dusty brick-red and ivory baseball club, soft caps and sparse pinstriped front panels. Warm offbeat physical cartoon acting with satirical vulnerable personalities, no glossy Pixar-human clichés.
BODY LOCK: Every character is one complete continuous FOOTLESS charcoal-black ink splat with subtle dark violet sheen, softly rounded thick asymmetric lobes, a few droplets, huge face directly in goo and short goo hands. Upright facing camera, full silhouette. NO human torso, legs, feet, trouser anatomy, cropped bust, animal body, alternate material body. Sports are expressed through hands, facial acting and props. Costumes are SMALL collar/shoulder/front-bib accents, bare ink dominates. Premium handmade plasticine fingerprint texture, rounded rich volumes, softly lit upper left. Every visible eye has WHITE/IVORY sclera around RED iris around BLACK pupil; thick fully filled purple-black eyelids. Helmets/visors do not cover eyes. Female-read cues subtly sculpted lids/lashes/quiff, no breasts or human hips. Six different mouth actions and bodily shapes. Teeth ONLY descend from upper gum INSIDE open mouth; never on outside lower lip, closed mouths toothless. No human pink lipstick.
TOP LEFT — Pitch Pünktlich; male-read. Narrow top-heavy droplet blob, cap backward, intense mismatched wide stare, tiny anxious closed mouth; brick-red collar and short ivory pinstripe panel; holds one stitched baseball close to face with delicate fingertips.
TOP MIDDLE — Cora Fangfrage; female-read. Broad squat scalloped blob, subtle lashes and dry one-eyelid squint, irritated two-upper-tooth complaint; catcher cap, small leather chest bib, giant thick mitt in one hand; wire catcher mask carried at SIDE below face, eyes fully unobscured.
TOP RIGHT — Hank Hauptsache; male-read. Pear-shaped robust blob, enormous crooked laughing grin upper teeth inside mouth, proud high ink crest under red cap; tiny ivory collar; holds one thick wooden baseball bat vertically beside body, complete bat within cell.
BOTTOM LEFT — Stella Kurzschluss; female-read. Lean crescent blob with little side quiff, lively lashed eyes and toothless sly smile; red visor, small pinstriped collar; worn leather fielding glove held open low, other hand poised in a short sharp pointing gesture.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Floyd Fernsicht; male-read. Tall wavy column blob, cap perched crooked, huge eyes staring upwards in mild existential alarm, uneven small open mouth; brick-red scarf and one pinstriped shoulder patch; mitt raised at chest while free hand shades brow.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Lou Laufzettel; male-read. Wide offset-lobed blob with swept ink curl, heavy suspicious eyelids and closed sideways sneer; soft ivory cap with red peak, red collar; holds one small dusty square fabric base bag under arm like a briefcase.
COMPOSITION: landscape 1536x1024, three equal columns by two equal rows, equal generously sized character scale in BOTH rows. Each silhouette and all props fit approximately 450x440px within its 512x512 logical cell with at least32px clean transparent gutters. Keep all6 substantial, no tiny bottom row, no automatic excessive padding, no overlap or clipping. No ground, floor, field, court, scenelet, shadows disc, labels, lettering, jersey numbers, logos, real brands, team names in pixels, grid lines, frame, scenery. True transparent background. Individual actors must also read alone. Restrained one/two bold coherent identity anchors; avoid extra clutter or inherited tongue gags.
